extraction_limitations: The article is a single-arm study and many comparative claims use historical cohorts; those comparisons were tagged and not treated as randomized evidence.
Underlying referenced trials were not re-atomized from this article; the reference queue is provided for primary-source follow-up.

Appendix tables were used for contextual/visual reconciliation, but not every cell was converted into an atom because they contain secondary comparisons or repeated safety detail rather than distinct primary claims.
No human reviewer verification has been recorded; review_status is extracted rather than verified.
